Design review · 12 October 2026 · preview on sample data

The Creator's Remedy, realigned

The storefront now follows the client's latest direction from the shared design session: Nuda's green and mint with the client's adjustments (a little pink, gold lettering, no orange), heavy headlines, pill buttons, a logo-left menu with a slide-out phone panel and a quiz button, a ticker and scroll motion, and an Elise-style cream footer. The customer's logo is used as supplied once the file is added.

What the client decided, in order

Elise, then brighter

Elise's structure, then "bright colours like Nuda's hero", then "use the colours like it is in Nuda".

Green, a little pink, gold

"Didn't like orange; green is fine, a little pink is fine, and gold writings."

The logo stays as it is

The customer keeps the original logo colours; the website's gold follows the logo's amber.
